$comment: Every score ContextWeave emits, declared against contracts/score_envelope.json. tests/test_score_contract.py holds this file to the contract and resolves every producer.

scores.name: contextweave.synthesis_confidence
scores.meaning: The synthesiser model's own confidence in its answer, parsed from its JSON output. Self-report; not checked against correctness. Fallback constants are not scores: confidenceReported=false means unobserved.

scores.name: contextweave.grounding
scores.meaning: Fraction of the answer's claims supported by at least one passage the chosen strategy retrieved (lexical verifier). Null when there are no passages or no checkable claims.

scores.name: contextweave.judge
scores.meaning: An independent judge model's grade of the answer against the retrieved passages, on a hash sample of queries.

scores.name: contextweave.routing_reward
scores.meaning: Weighted mean of the observed reward signals under ROUTER_REWARD_SOURCE; what the router learns from. A mean of same-scale [0,1] quality grades by design (see verified_reward.py); null when nothing was observed.

scores.name: contextweave.human_rating
scores.meaning: A caller's rating of an answer via POST /feedback (up=1, neutral=0.5, down=0).

scores.name: contextweave.routing_posterior_mean
scores.event: expected routing reward of this strategy for this question type
scores.evidence: alpha + beta - prior strength (feedback_count on the edge)
scores.meaning: Mean of the Beta posterior on an EFFECTIVE_FOR edge. As meaningful as the reward that feeds it.

scores.name: contextweave.selection_propensity
scores.calibration_ref: exact by construction: Monte Carlo estimate (ROUTER_PROPENSITY_SAMPLES draws) of P(Thompson sampling selects this arm | posteriors at decision time)
scores.event: Thompson sampling selects this strategy at decision time
scores.meaning: The one genuine probability in the inventory; used as an importance-weight denominator for off-policy evaluation.
